comment:
§1.2.3, p. 16, lines 257–258. [highlight] On the text: «outside».
I would prefer to say:
that cuts across the health system as well as ....
(it is for sure not outside the health system)
IFMIS for example can be considered as part of DPI, and it is part of PFM. So "adjacent" does better justice to these connections.
